user.title: MCZ Maestro
user.description: Choose how to connect to the stove.

bluetooth_pick.title: Select the stove
bluetooth_pick.description: Pick the MCZ panel to connect to over Bluetooth.

pairing.title: Put the stove in pairing mode
pairing.description: Set the display in pairing mode before continuing: press + and − together, or cut the mains power for a few seconds (after reboot the display is also in pairing mode). Then submit to finish.

data.read_only: Diagnostic mode: read only, no command sent to the stove

data_description.read_only: Leave this ticked to validate the Bluetooth link on readings alone. As long as it is on, the integration refuses every local write, so no entity or automation can start or stop the stove. It can be turned off later in the integration options.

hybrid.title: Hybrid (cloud + Bluetooth)
hybrid.description: Enter your MCZ Maestro account and select the local Bluetooth panel.

error.invalid_mac: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

abort.no_devices_found: No MCZ panels were found. Put the display in pairing mode (press + and − together, or power-cycle the stove) and make sure it is in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

data.read_only: Diagnostic mode: read only, no command sent to the stove

data_description.read_only: When on, the local Bluetooth link never writes a register. In Bluetooth-only mode every command is refused; in hybrid mode commands are sent through the cloud as usual.

ble_read_registers.name: Read Bluetooth registers
ble_read_registers.description: Read a range of Modbus holding registers over the local Bluetooth link and return every plausible interpretation of each value. Read-only.

start.name: Start register
start.description: First register to read, as a decimal number or a hexadecimal string (for example 0x03FA).

count.name: Count
count.description: Number of consecutive registers to read (1 to 125).

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Config entry to query. Leave empty to use the first entry that owns a Bluetooth transport.

ble_probe_fans.name: Probe fan registers
ble_probe_fans.description: Read the candidate registers for the second and third room fan and compare them with the cloud values when a cloud connection is available. Read-only.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Config entry to query. Leave empty to use the first entry that owns a Bluetooth transport.

ble_dump.name: Dump a register range
ble_dump.description: Sweep a register range in blocks of 32 and return only the registers whose value is neither 0 nor 0xFFFF. At most 512 registers per call. Read-only.

start.name: Start register
start.description: First register of the range, as a decimal number or a hexadecimal string (for example 0x05FD).

end.name: End register
end.description: Last register of the range, inclusive, as a decimal number or a hexadecimal string (for example 0x0605).

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Config entry to query. Leave empty to use the first entry that owns a Bluetooth transport.
